entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: The guardian of the Mirari who keeps his promise to a dying Chainer to keep the orb safe from others and himself.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A potent orb that corrupts Kamahl and is ultimately implanted into the Krosan Forest, causing flora and fauna to grow larger and wilder.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A dying figure to whom Kamahl made a promise to keep the Mirari safe.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A character who attempts to obtain the Mirari; his corpse is used to implant the orb in the Krosan Forest.

entities.name: Eesha
entities.description: A character who attempts to obtain the Mirari.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, who endeavors to separate the Mirari from Kamahl.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Kamahl's mentor, who endeavors to separate the Mirari from Kamahl.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: The forest into which the Mirari is implanted, making its fauna and flora grow larger and wilder.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent on Dominaria where Judgment takes place.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Judgment takes place.

events.summary: Kamahl keeps the Mirari safe from others and himself, keeping his promise to a dying Chainer.
events.quote: keeps the Mirari safe from others and himself

events.summary: Laquatus and Eesha try to obtain the Mirari while Jeska and Balthor try to separate it from Kamahl for fear of its corrupting influence.
events.quote: attempt to obtain the potent orb for themselves

events.summary: After politics and war, the Mirari, attached to Kamahl's sword, is implanted through Laquatus's corpse into the Krosan Forest, channeling its magic into the land.
events.quote: is implanted through the corpse of Laquatus and into the Krosan Forest

events.summary: A majority of the characters are killed and the influence of the Mirari on individuals is diminished.
events.quote: A majority of the characters are killed

relations.note: Keeps a promise made to the dying Chainer.
relations.quote: in keeping truth to his promise made to a dying Chainer

Kamahl's sister and mentor, Jeska and Balthor

relations.note: Attempts to obtain the Mirari from him.
